corrections.field_01: Strongest feature: Argument connects a stipulated commencement of matter, energy, space, and time to explanatory requirements transcending material causation, while identifying volitional capacity as mechanism for originating a temporally bounded physical order. Principal limitation: Excluding material antecedents does not uniquely establish personal agency, because unknown nonmaterial principles or foundational explanations remain insufficiently examined despite acknowledged uncertainty. Live burden: The case must demonstrate why transcendence entails volition, rather than causal independence, and why rival origin accounts cannot satisfy adequacy conditions without importing unexplained agency or exceeding evidence. Locked score: The assessment appropriately reflects a centrally relevant, carefully recoverable, and substantially coherent constructive inference whose evidential warrant and treatment of alternatives remain meaningfully weaker than its burden contact.
corrections.field_02: Strongest feature: The reply identifies the methodological boundary separating conditional mathematics from physical conclusion: classical spacetime assumptions cannot determine earliest regimes amid measurement failure when an unavailable quantum-gravity framework is needed. Principal limitation: The objection could acknowledge that incomplete applicability need not erase evidential contribution, since a classical theorem may retain conditional significance without describing the foundational regime. Live burden: The response must show that assumptions fail enough to block the claimed beginning, while distinguishing epistemic restraint from the suggestion that theory provides no support whatsoever. Locked score: The assessment appropriately reflects a direct, disciplined, well-calibrated diagnostic reply that engages targeted inferences while preserving qualification, representational charity, and the central limitation on theorem-based cosmological conclusions.
